description.value: BC Liquor Store is a provincially operated retail outlet in Stewart, one of the most remote communities in British Columbia, situated at the end of the Stewart-Cassiar highway near the Alaska border. Part of BCLIQUOR's network of 198 stores across the province, it offers wine, beer, spirits, ciders, and coolers, and accepts card and contactless payment. For cyclists completing the remote northern BC routes, it is a rare resupply point for alcoholic beverages in a town with very limited retail options.
